newsitem.title: UK: Hambros names Chips Keswick as new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Hambros names Chips Keswick as new chairman.

text.p: British investment bank Hambros said on Wednesday that its chairman Lord Hambro would retire at the bank's annual meeting in July next year and would be succeeded by Sir Chips Keswick.

"Having served since 1983 as chairman of the group, I think it right I should now make way for the younger generation and will accordingly be retiring as chairman with effect from the annual general meeting in July 1997," Hambro said in his chairman's statement accompanying the bank's interim results.
Keswick is group chief executive of Hambros Plc and will remain chairman of its Hambros Bank unit.
Hambro added that he was delighted to have been asked to maintain what he called a "life-long association with the business" by continuing to serve as a non-executive director.
